name: algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/examples/algotune/eigenvectors_complex/AGENT.python.tools.md

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.run_solver_eigenvectors: run the eigenvectors complex solver on a square matrix and return sorted eigenvectors

algorithmicsuperintelligence_openevolve/.refactor_eigenvector_solver: refactor the EigenvectorsComplex.solve method to use iterative methods like power iteration or Lanczos
